title: Uruguayan Lamb Terrine
description: A flavorful and savory terrine made with tender lamb, served with a tangy mustard sauce.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Make sure to handle the lamb at a safe temperature to avoid bacterial contamination.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount according to your preference.

ingredients.name: Terrine
ingredients.notes: You can use a store-bought terrine or make your own at home.

ingredients.name: Mustard
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount according to your preference.

ingredients.name: Amorous
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or dried parsley according to your preference.

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chopped lamb, Uruguayan spices, and terrine meat.
Mix well until the ingredients are evenly distributed.
Transfer the mixture to a terrine mold or a small loaf pan.
Cover the terrine with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the terrine is cooked through.
While the terrine is baking, prepare the mustard sauce by mixing the Dijon mustard with a little bit of water until you get a smooth consistency.
Once the terrine is done, let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving with the mustard sauce.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
